paite: Gam tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in kikou un.
heading: Phatna La / Kipahthu Genna

paite: Kipak kawm in TOUPA nna sem unla; la sa kawm in ama ah hong pai un.
TOUPA tuh Pathian ahi chih thei un; hon bawlpa amah ahi a, amah a i hi ua; amite leh agantatna mun a belamte i hi.
Kipahthu gen kawm in akongkhak ah lut unla, phat kawm in ahuangsung intual ah lut un; akiang ah kipahthu gen unla, amin phat un.
TOUPA ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi, amuanhuaidan suan tengteng tan in a-om ding hi.
